# Jabbit - Peptide Tracking App
> Jabbit is a privacy-first iOS app for tracking peptide injections, managing vials, calculating reconstitution, and visualizing serum levels.

## Key Features
- Smart injection tracking with 14-zone site rotation
- Vial management with reconstitution calculator
- Real-time serum level visualization (pharmacokinetic curves)
- Flexible dosing schedules (daily, EOD, 2x/week, 5-on-2-off, custom)
- Titration and cycle planning
- Progress tracking with Apple Health sync
- In-app encyclopedia of peptides with half-life data
- Privacy-first: iCloud sync only, no server storage

## Pricing
- 14-day free trial
- $9.99/year (founding member pricing, normally $19.99/year)
